floatingShare.sentence: As of June 30, 2026, 96.1% of our debt investments based on fair value bore interest at floating rates, with 100.0% of these subject to interest rate floors, which we believe helps act as a portfolio-wide hedge against inflation.

portfolioCompanies.sentence: As of June 30, 2026, we had investments in 137 portfolio companies (including 33 structured credit investments, which include each series of collateralized loan obligation as a separate portfolio company investment) with an aggregate fair value of $3,302.1 million.
